subject: Uploading Fortran executable files to shinyapps?

messages.author: d410f9527641a548
messages.subject: Uploading Fortran executable files to shinyapps?
parts:
I'm trying to include an executable file with my shinyapp that calls some Fortran code to create model results. These results are then plotted by shiny. Everything works fine using a local version of the app (Windows 7) by invoking system commands with R code. The app uploads to shinyapps without errors but the results are not updated when the input is changed. I realize the problem could be related to several issues but I thought I'd ask regardless.  Can executable files that call Fortran code be uploaded to shinyapps?  I also attempted to upload the same code but  compiled as a Linux executable.  Still no luck.  The log file on Shinyapps continues to say the executable file cannot be found.


Thanks,

Marcus

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Uploading Fortran executable files to shinyapps?
parts:
Hi Marcus,
Unfortunately shinyapps.io is built to run on Linux (Ubuntu 14.04) so executables that aren't pre-built for that operating system will not work.

-Tareef
